# Generated conformance data

This directory is generated by `make prepare-blueprint-testdata` from the
tracked archive `../blueprint-vectors.tar.gz`, which the same target refreshes
from the pinned `fixtures/cardano-blueprint` Git submodule. Do not edit or
commit the contents of `eras/`; the importer verifies the Blueprint revision
and archive checksum before extracting the exact vector bytes and protocol
parameters.

`eras/` is ignored, so it does not reach downstream modules. Consumers get the
same corpus from the embedded archive via `conformance.ExtractEmbeddedTestdata`.

See [../CORPUS.md](../CORPUS.md) for provenance, inventory, format boundaries,
and the distinction between ledger, consensus, wire, and synthetic fixtures.
